舟.name: Boat
舟.reading: Row it in your shoes, しゅう. On its own it's ふね.

航.name: Navigate
航.meaning: A <radical>boat</radical> with a <radical>top hat</radical> on a <radical>table</radical>. The captain spreads the chart on the table to <kanji>navigate</kanji>.
航.reading: The captain is a koala, こう. 航空 is aviation; 航海 a voyage.

旧.name: Old Times
旧.meaning: A <radical>stick</radical> next to the <radical>sun</radical>. A sundial from the <kanji>old times</kanji>.
旧.reading: Hit it with a cue stick, きゅう. 旧 means former: 旧友, an old friend.

児.name: Child
児.meaning: <radical>Old times</radical> on little <radical>legs</radical>. The newest arrival has an old soul: a <kanji>child</kanji>.
児.reading: Riding in a jeep, じ. 児童 is children; 小児科 paediatrics (に).

印.name: Seal
印.meaning: A <radical>stick</radical> with a <radical>slide</radical> and a <radical>stamp</radical>. Press it down: a <kanji>seal</kanji>.
印.reading: At the inn, いん, you stamp the register. 印象 is impression; 印 a mark (しるし).

冊.name: Volume
冊.meaning: A <radical>helmet</radical> over <radical>clasped hands</radical>. Bamboo strips tied together: a <kanji>volume</kanji>. It counts books.
冊.reading: Beamed from a satellite, さつ. 一冊 is one book.

輪.name: Wheel
輪.meaning: A <radical>car</radical>, a <radical>person</radical> on the <radical>ground</radical> and a <radical>volume</radical>. Spokes in a row, like a book's pages: a <kanji>wheel</kanji>.
輪.reading: Round as a ring, りん. 車輪 is a wheel; 輪 a ring (わ).

清.name: Pure
清.reading: Sail on it, せい. 清潔 is clean; 清い pure.

億.name: Hundred Million
億.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> with an <radical>idea</radical>. A brilliant idea could earn a <kanji>hundred million</kanji> yen.
億.reading: An ogre, おく, tries to steal it. 一億 is 100,000,000.

芸.name: Art
芸.meaning: <radical>Grass</radical> over <radical>two</radical> and something <radical>private</radical>. Growing a secret garden is a real <kanji>art</kanji>.
芸.reading: Performers wait at the gate, げい. 芸術 is art; 芸能人 a celebrity.

停.name: Stop
停.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> next to a <radical>pavilion</radical>. They <kanji>stop</kanji> for a rest.
停.reading: At a picnic table, てい. 停電 is a power cut; バス停 a bus stop.

陸.name: Land
陸.meaning: A <radical>building</radical> on <radical>dirt</radical> on <radical>legs</radical>. Buildings stand on solid <kanji>land</kanji>.
陸.reading: By rickshaw, りく. 大陸 is a continent; 陸上 on land.

帯.name: Belt
帯.meaning: <radical>Clasped hands</radical>, <radical>twenty</radical>, a <radical>lid</radical> and a <radical>towel</radical>. Twenty knots in a cloth: a <kanji>belt</kanji>.
帯.reading: Tie it like a tie, たい. 携帯 is a mobile phone; 帯 an obi (おび).

固.name: Hard
固.meaning: Something <radical>old</radical> inside an <radical>enclosure</radical>. Leave it long enough and it goes <kanji>hard</kanji>.
固.reading: Like a cobra skin, こ. 固い is hard; 固定 fixed.

囲.name: Surround
囲.meaning: A <radical>well</radical> inside an <radical>enclosure</radical>. A fence to <kanji>surround</kanji> the well.
囲.reading: An eel, い, lives in it. 周囲 is surroundings; 雰囲気 atmosphere.

卒.name: Graduate
卒.meaning: A <radical>top hat</radical> over a <radical>person</radical> and a <radical>cross</radical>. Mortarboards on: you <kanji>graduate</kanji>.
卒.reading: Celebrate with a sausage, そつ. 卒業 is graduation.

順.name: Order
順.meaning: A <radical>river</radical> and a <radical>head</radical>. Heads float down the river in <kanji>order</kanji>.
順.reading: Every June, じゅん. 順番 is turn; 順調 smooth.

令.name: Order
令.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> with a roof, the <radical>ground</radical> and <radical>mama</radical> beneath. Mama gives the <kanji>order</kanji>.
令.reading: With a ray gun, れい. 命令 is an order; 令和 the current era.

貨.name: Goods
貨.reading: Load them into the car, か. 貨物 is freight; 通貨 currency.

季.name: Season
季.meaning: <radical>Grain</radical> over a <radical>child</radical>. The grain grows up like a child, one <kanji>season</kanji> at a time.
季.reading: Unlock the seasons with a key, き. 季節 is a season.

香.name: Fragrance
香.meaning: <radical>Grain</radical> in the <radical>sun</radical>. Warm grain has a lovely <kanji>fragrance</kanji>.
香.reading: A koala, こう, sniffs it. 香水 is perfume; 香り scent (かおり).

底.name: Bottom
底.meaning: A <radical>clan</radical> on the <radical>ground</radical> under a <radical>canopy</radical>. They sit at the very <kanji>bottom</kanji>.
底.reading: Under a table, てい. 底 is そこ; 徹底 thoroughness.

布.name: Cloth
布.meaning: A hand spreading a <kanji>cloth</kanji> on a hook, like a towel on a rail.
布.reading: Stepped on by a hoof, ふ. 布 is ぬの; 毛布 a blanket.

希.name: Hope
希.meaning: <radical>Cloth</radical> with a <radical>slide</radical> across it: an X marks the spot. The treasure map gives you <kanji>hope</kanji>.
希.reading: It needs a key, き. 希望 is hope.

仲.name: Relationship
仲.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> in the <radical>middle</radical>. They connect two people: a <kanji>relationship</kanji>.
仲.reading: なか: they're "knock-kneed" friends. 仲間 is a companion; 仲良し close friends.

栄.name: Prosper
栄.meaning: <radical>Sparkle</radical> over a <radical>lid</radical> over a <radical>tree</radical>. A glowing tree: you <kanji>prosper</kanji>.
栄.reading: Deal an ace, えい. 栄養 is nutrition; 栄える to prosper.

札.name: Bill
札.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical> and a <radical>swan</radical>. A tag of wood with a swan on it: a <kanji>bill</kanji>.
札.reading: Printed by satellite, さつ. お札 is a banknote; 改札 a ticket gate.

包.name: Wrap
包.reading: Wrap a hose, ほう, around too. 包む is to wrap; 包帯 a bandage.

焼.name: Bake
焼.meaning: <radical>Fire</radical> with a <radical>cross</radical>, <radical>clasped hands</radical>, <radical>ground</radical> and <radical>legs</radical>. Pile everything on the fire and <kanji>bake</kanji>.
焼.reading: やく: grill a yak. 焼く is to bake; 焼き鳥 grilled chicken. しょう in compounds.

照.name: Illuminate
照.reading: For a show, しょう. 照明 is lighting; 照らす to shine on.

漁.name: Fishing
漁.reading: Catch a gyoza, ぎょ. 漁業 is the fishing industry; 漁師 a fisherman (りょう).

貯.name: Save
貯.meaning: A <radical>shell</radical>, a <radical>roof</radical> and a <radical>street</radical>. Keep money under your roof: <kanji>save</kanji>.
貯.reading: In a chocolate box, ちょ. 貯金 is savings.

訓.name: Instruction
訓.meaning: <radical>Say</radical> it like a <radical>river</radical> flowing. A stream of <kanji>instruction</kanji>. It also names the kun'yomi.
訓.reading: Taught to a coon hound, くん. 訓読み is kun reading; 訓練 training.

浴.name: Bathe
浴.reading: Wash off the egg yolk, よく. 浴びる is to bathe; 浴衣 yukata.

塩.name: Salt
塩.meaning: <radical>Dirt</radical>, a <radical>gun</radical>, a <radical>mouth</radical> and a <radical>plate</radical>. Shoot the dirt, and what lands on your plate is <kanji>salt</kanji>.
塩.reading: A pinch costs a yen, えん. 塩 is しお.

兆.name: Omen
兆.meaning: <radical>Legs</radical> and <radical>ice</radical> cracks. Cracks in the ice are an <kanji>omen</kanji>. Also a trillion.
兆.reading: Broken chocolate, ちょう, is a bad omen. 一兆 is a trillion.

祝.name: Celebrate
祝.meaning: An <radical>altar</radical> and your <radical>older brother</radical>. He's getting married: <kanji>celebrate</kanji>.
祝.reading: Under shooting stars, しゅく. 祝日 is a holiday; 祝う to celebrate.

衣.name: Clothes
衣.reading: Worn by an eel, い. 衣服 is clothing; 衣 ころも.

臣.name: Retainer
臣.meaning: A wide-open eye bowing low. A loyal <kanji>retainer</kanji>.
臣.reading: Kneeling on his shins, しん. 大臣 is a minister (じん).

浅.name: Shallow
浅.meaning: <radical>Water</radical>, <radical>three</radical> and a <radical>halberd</radical>. The water only reaches three notches up the halberd: <kanji>shallow</kanji>.
浅.reading: あさい: shallow as the "ah, sigh" when you hit bottom. 浅い is shallow. せん in compounds.

勇.name: Courage
勇.meaning: <radical>Mama</radical> over a <radical>man</radical>. Standing up to Mama takes <kanji>courage</kanji>.
勇.reading: Play the ukulele, ゆう, for courage. 勇気 is courage.

械.name: Machine
械.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical> and a <radical>commandment</radical>. Wood built by strict rules: a <kanji>machine</kanji>.
械.reading: It flies like a kite, かい. 機械 is a machine.

菜.name: Vegetable
菜.reading: Harvest with a scythe, さい. 野菜 is vegetables.

刷.name: Print
刷.meaning: A <radical>flag</radical>, a <radical>towel</radical> and a <radical>knife</radical>. Cut a stencil, wipe on ink, <kanji>print</kanji> the flag.
刷.reading: Beam it to a satellite, さつ. 印刷 is printing.

孫.name: Grandchild
孫.meaning: A <radical>child</radical> in the <radical>lineage</radical>. Your child's child: <kanji>grandchild</kanji>.
孫.reading: Found by sonar, そん, in the family tree. 孫 is まご.

毒.name: Poison
毒.meaning: <radical>Three</radical> over a <radical>mother</radical>. Three drops and she knows it's <kanji>poison</kanji>.

粉.name: Powder
粉.reading: Throw it at a fun fair, ふん. 粉 is こな; 花粉 pollen.

灯.name: Lamp
灯.reading: A toad, とう, sits under it. 電灯 is an electric light.

胃.name: Stomach
胃.meaning: A <radical>rice paddy</radical> over the <radical>moon</radical> (flesh). Where your rice goes: the <kanji>stomach</kanji>.
胃.reading: An eel, い, wriggles in there. 胃 is the stomach.

総.name: General
総.meaning: <radical>Thread</radical>, the <radical>public</radical> and a <radical>heart</radical>. Everything tied together: the <kanji>general</kanji> whole.
総.reading: Kept in a soda can, そう. 総理大臣 is prime minister.

領.name: Territory
領.meaning: An <radical>order</radical> from the <radical>head</radical>. The ruler claims the <kanji>territory</kanji>.
領.reading: At the rodeo, りょう. 大統領 is a president; 領収書 a receipt.

設.name: Establish
設.meaning: <radical>Say</radical> it and hold up a <radical>weapon</radical>. That's how you <kanji>establish</kanji> a new rule.
設.reading: With a whole set, せつ, of tools. 設備 is equipment; 建設 construction.

査.name: Investigate
査.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical> and <radical>moreover</radical>. Look at every tree, and moreover every root: <kanji>investigate</kanji>.
査.reading: Saw through it, <reading>さ</reading>. <ja>調査</ja> is investigation; <ja>検査</ja> inspection.

団.name: Group
団.meaning: <radical>Glue</radical> inside an <radical>enclosure</radical>. Everyone stuck together: a <kanji>group</kanji>.
団.reading: A dance troupe, だん. 団体 is a group; 布団 futon (とん).

勢.name: Force
勢.meaning: <radical>Dirt</radical>, <radical>legs</radical>, something <radical>round</radical> and <radical>power</radical>. A boulder rolling downhill has <kanji>force</kanji>.
勢.reading: Sail with the wind, せい. 大勢 is a crowd (ぜい); 勢い momentum.

減.name: Decrease
減.meaning: <radical>Water</radical> by a <radical>cliff</radical>, a <radical>halberd</radical>, the <radical>ground</radical> and a <radical>mouth</radical>. Soldiers drink the well dry: the water <kanji>decrease</kanji>s.
減.reading: A genie, げん, won't refill it. 減る is to decrease.

再.name: Again
再.meaning: The <radical>ground</radical>, a <radical>helmet</radical> and <radical>dirt</radical>. Put the helmet back on the dirt and try <kanji>again</kanji>.
再.reading: Swing the scythe, さい, again. 再来年 is the year after next.

税.name: Tax
税.meaning: <radical>Grain</radical>, <radical>eight</radical> and your <radical>older brother</radical>. He takes eight bags of grain: <kanji>tax</kanji>.
税.reading: Carried on a zebra, ぜい. 税金 is tax.

営.name: Manage
営.meaning: <radical>Sparkle</radical> and a <radical>lid</radical> over a <radical>spine</radical>. A shiny sign on a sturdy building: you <kanji>manage</kanji> a business.
営.reading: You're an ace, えい, at it. 営業 is business, sales.

比.name: Compare
比.meaning: Two people side by side. <kanji>Compare</kanji> them.
比.reading: Compare their heels, ひ. 比べる is to compare.

防.name: Prevent
防.meaning: A <radical>building</radical> facing every <radical>direction</radical>. A fort to <kanji>prevent</kanji> attack.
防.reading: With a bow and arrow, ぼう. 予防 is prevention; 防ぐ to prevent.

境.name: Boundary
境.meaning: <radical>Dirt</radical>, a <radical>sound</radical> and <radical>legs</radical>. Walk along the dirt until you hear the border guard: the <kanji>boundary</kanji>.
境.reading: Between Kyoto and the next town, きょう. 環境 is environment; 国境 national border.

導.name: Guide
導.meaning: A <radical>road</radical> and <radical>glue</radical>. Stick to the road: follow the <kanji>guide</kanji>.
導.reading: Towards a donut shop, どう. 指導 is guidance; 導く to lead.

輸.name: Transport
輸.meaning: A <radical>car</radical> next to <radical>enter</radical>, <radical>ground</radical>, <radical>moon</radical> and <radical>knife</radical>. Load the car and <kanji>transport</kanji> it.
輸.reading: On a unicorn, ゆ. 輸出 is export; 輸入 import.

述.name: State
述.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical> with a <radical>drop</radical> on a <radical>scooter</radical>. Ride round town and <kanji>state</kanji> your case.
述.reading: Like a jujitsu master, じゅつ. 述べる is to state.

武.name: Military
武.meaning: The <radical>ground</radical>, a <radical>ceremony</radical> stake and <radical>stop</radical>. Soldiers march up and stop at the stake: <kanji>military</kanji>.
武.reading: In heavy boots, ぶ. 武器 is a weapon; 武士 a samurai.

額.name: Forehead
額.meaning: A <radical>guest</radical> next to a <radical>head</radical>. The guest bows and you see their <kanji>forehead</kanji>.
額.reading: A goose honks "がく" and pecks it. 金額 is an amount of money; 額 forehead (ひたい).

準.name: Standard
準.meaning: <radical>Water</radical>, a <radical>turkey</radical> and a <radical>cross</radical>. Check the water level with a turkey: that's the <kanji>standard</kanji>.
準.reading: Every June, じゅん. 準備 is preparation; 基準 a standard.

造.name: Create
造.meaning: <radical>Tell</radical> on a <radical>scooter</radical>. Ride round telling everyone what you'll <kanji>create</kanji>.
造.reading: An elephant, ぞう. 製造 is manufacturing; 造る to build.

技.name: Skill
技.reading: A goose honks "ぎ" at it. 技術 is technology; 演技 acting.

復.name: Restore
復.meaning: <radical>Going</radical>, a <radical>gun</radical>, the <radical>sun</radical> and <radical>winter</radical>. Go back after winter and <kanji>restore</kanji> things.
復.reading: Hang them back on the hook, ふく. 復習 is review; 往復 round trip.

移.name: Move
移.meaning: <radical>Grain</radical> and <radical>many</radical>. Too much grain: <kanji>move</kanji> some elsewhere.
移.reading: An eel, い, helps. 移動 is moving; 移る to move.

個.name: Individual
個.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> who is <radical>hard</radical>. Stubborn: an <kanji>individual</kanji>. It also counts small things.
個.reading: Like a cobra, こ. 個人 is individual; 一個 one thing.

接.name: Contact
接.meaning: <radical>Fingers</radical>, <radical>stand</radical> and <radical>woman</radical>. Stand up and shake hands: make <kanji>contact</kanji>.
接.reading: Hand over a set, せつ. 面接 is an interview; 直接 direct.

効.name: Effect
効.reading: Works on a koala, こう. 効果 is effect; 効く to be effective.

券.name: Ticket
券.meaning: <radical>Two</radical>, <radical>big</radical> and a <radical>sword</radical>. Cut a big paper in two: a <kanji>ticket</kanji>.
券.reading: Ken, けん, checks them. 切符 is a ticket, and 券 too: 食券, meal ticket.

編.name: Knit
編.meaning: <radical>Thread</radical>, a <radical>door</radical> and a <radical>volume</radical>. <kanji>Knit</kanji> thread into a volume: compile.
編.reading: A hen, へん, does the knitting. 編集 is editing; 編む to knit.

採.name: Gather
採.reading: With a scythe, さい. 採用 is adoption, hiring.

貿.name: Trade
貿.reading: Shoot a bow and arrow, ぼう, at pirates. 貿易 is trade.

講.name: Lecture
講.meaning: <radical>Say</radical>, <radical>three</radical> and <radical>again</radical>. Say it three times again: a <kanji>lecture</kanji>.
講.reading: Given by a koala, こう. 講義 is a lecture.

河.name: River
河.reading: Wash your car, か, in it. 河川 is rivers; 銀河 galaxy.

禁.name: Forbid
禁.meaning: A <radical>grove</radical> over a <radical>show</radical>. The sacred grove shows a sign: <kanji>forbid</kanji>den.
禁.reading: By order of the king, きん. 禁止 is prohibition; 禁煙 no smoking.

逆.name: Reverse
逆.meaning: A <radical>sprout</radical> upside down on a <radical>scooter</radical>. Everything's in <kanji>reverse</kanji>.
逆.reading: It's a gag gift, ぎゃく. 逆 is the opposite.

久.name: Long Time
久.meaning: A person bent over, walking with a cane. They've been walking a <kanji>long time</kanji>.
久.reading: Leaning on a cue stick, きゅう. 久しぶり is long time no see (ひさ).

暴.name: Violence
暴.meaning: The <radical>sun</radical> over <radical>together</radical> and a <radical>splash</radical>. Everyone boils over in the heat: <kanji>violence</kanji>.
暴.reading: With a bow and arrow, ぼう. 暴力 is violence; 暴れる to rampage.

均.name: Level
均.reading: Fit for a king, きん. 平均 is average.

圧.name: Pressure
圧.meaning: <radical>Dirt</radical> under a <radical>cliff</radical>. The cliff presses down: <kanji>pressure</kanji>.
圧.reading: A hat full of hot soup, あつ, presses on your head. 気圧 is air pressure.

則.name: Rule
則.meaning: A <radical>shell</radical> and a <radical>knife</radical>. Cut the money fairly: that's the <kanji>rule</kanji>.
則.reading: Wear matching socks, そく. That's a rule. 規則 is a rule.

測.name: Measure
測.reading: With a wet sock, そく. 測る is to measure; 予測 a prediction.

豊.name: Abundant
豊.meaning: <radical>Music</radical> over a <radical>bean</radical>. A great harvest with music: <kanji>abundant</kanji>.
豊.reading: Water it with a hose, ほう. 豊富 is abundant; 豊か rich.

厚.name: Thick
厚.meaning: The <radical>sun</radical> and a <radical>child</radical> under a <radical>cliff</radical>. A <kanji>thick</kanji> rock roof keeps them safe.
厚.reading: A koala, こう, in a thick coat. 厚い is thick.

略.name: Abbreviation
略.meaning: A <radical>rice paddy</radical> for <radical>each</radical> person. Too many to list: use an <kanji>abbreviation</kanji>.
略.reading: Pack it in a rucksack, りゃく. 省略 is abbreviation.
